about_body_1.en: I'm a Robotics Engineering student with a passion for designing mechanical systems and writing the software that brings them to life. I work at the intersection of hardware and software — from CAD models to embedded firmware to ROS nodes.
about_body_1.zh: 我是一名机器人工程专业的学生，热衷于设计机械系统，并编写让它们运转的软件。我在硬件与软件的交叉领域工作——从 CAD 模型到嵌入式固件，再到 ROS 节点。

about_body_2.en: Outside of engineering, I enjoy photography and running

projects_subheading.en: A selection of academic, personal, and team projects.

proj_arm_desc.en: Designed and fabricated a 6-degree-of-freedom robotic arm from scratch. Mechanical structure modeled in SolidWorks, driven by hobby servos, and controlled via a custom inverse kinematics solver in Python.
proj_arm_desc.zh: 从零设计并制作了一款六自由度机械臂。机械结构在 SolidWorks 中建模，由业余伺服舵机驱动，并通过自编写的 Python 逆运动学求解器进行控制。

proj_slam_title.en: Simulate automatic navigation and visual detection payload delivery system
proj_slam_title.zh: 模拟仓库自主导航侦测货物运送机器人

proj_slam_desc.en: An autonomous TurtleBot3 tasked with navigating a maze-like environment, locating two ArUco markers, and executing specific tasks at each marker without human intervention.
proj_slam_desc.zh: 完全自主运行的TurtleBot3，可达成迷宫般的环境中自主导航，定位两个ArUco标记点，并在每个标记点处执行特定任务.

bloomcraft_desc.en: Designed and trained an image generation model on a transformer architecture, producing varied floral images from an input prompt. Applied data augmentation and regularisation to improve generalisation, and deployed a simple web interface for interaction.
bloomcraft_desc.zh: 使用 transformer 架构设计并训练了一个图片生成模型，能够根据输入提示生成多样化的花卉图像。使用了数据增强和正则化技术来提升模型的泛化能力，并部署了一个简单的 Web 界面供用户交互。

proj_portfolio_desc.en: A minimal bilingual portfolio built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Supports English/Chinese toggle with localStorage persistence. Deployed to Vercel with a custom domain via Cloudflare DNS.
proj_portfolio_desc.zh: 使用 React、Vite 和 Tailwind CSS 构建的极简双语作品集网站，支持中英文切换并持久化存储语言偏好。通过 Cloudflare DNS 配置自定义域名并部署至 Vercel。

contact_subheading.en: I'm open to internships, research collaborations, and interesting side projects.
contact_subheading.zh: 随时欢迎实习、科研以及有趣项目
